title: family_release_end
description: End running releases early on each listed child device (kind missing = all releases; entity_id narrows kind entity). Ending is always allowed (only ever stricter). Family manager devices only (effective rule family_manager); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_result.

request_id.description: Optional id of the app, echoed in the answer.

client_ids.description: Child devices (e.g. all devices of one child). Each is checked on its own (family_result.results).
